households.history: A fire in an ancestral timber hall cost the family its estate; they retained kin and oath-service at Agilting.

people.name: Stenrik
people.life: Kept the evacuation orderly when his hall burned and still measures every promise against what can actually be carried out.
people.dream: earn stewardship through reliable service
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

people.name: Rannveig
people.life: Saved the household tally sticks from the fire and has since distrusted impressive words unsupported by an account.
people.dream: teach her daughters independent accounts
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

people.name: Halvdan
people.life: Led carts carrying the family dependents to Agilting and resents that his caution was mistaken for cowardice.
people.dream: win a reputation beyond his father
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

people.name: Yrdis
people.life: Lost her woven marriage cloth in the fire and now sells small commissions rather than accept a match arranged from pity.
people.dream: choose a marriage on equal terms
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

people.name: Torgeir
people.life: Was sent to learn gate duty after repeatedly gambling away small allowances; he now keeps his debts in plain view.
people.dream: repay a debt before seeking office
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

people.name: Svanfrid
people.life: Learned to carry messages between scattered relatives and notices more of a household dispute than elders expect.
people.dream: travel to the great northern ports
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

households.history: A disputed inheritance left the Askesund family without farms; their claim rests with kin rather than a royal grant.

people.name: Hrodvar
people.life: Accepted an unfavorable inheritance settlement to prevent a feud and still wonders whether restraint merely rewarded a liar.
people.dream: clear his family name before the Thing
people.appearanceFamily: square jaw, straight brows and grey-blue eyes

people.name: Sigruna
people.life: Brokered food and lodging while her husband argued the inheritance and has little patience for pride that neglects supper.
people.dream: keep the family out of another feud
people.appearanceFamily: square jaw, straight brows and grey-blue eyes

people.name: Ketilmar
people.life: Copied witness accounts for the inheritance dispute and became fascinated by the distance between law and persuasion.
people.dream: become a respected law-speaker
people.appearanceFamily: square jaw, straight brows and grey-blue eyes

people.name: Eydisa
people.life: Stayed with the victorious branch of the family for one winter and refuses to call every relative there an enemy.
people.dream: restore contact with estranged cousins
people.appearanceFamily: square jaw, straight brows and grey-blue eyes

people.name: Finnvald
people.life: Trained on the cliff paths around Tharklif and hides a fear of deep water behind jokes about sailors.
people.dream: prove useful without pretending to be a seaman
people.appearanceFamily: square jaw, straight brows and grey-blue eyes

people.name: Thyrdis
people.life: Learned to keep the family correspondence after a messenger misquoted her mother and now reads every letter aloud twice.
people.dream: master letters without losing her blunt voice
people.appearanceFamily: square jaw, straight brows and grey-blue eyes

households.history: The family once supervised woodland cutting rights; the rights passed elsewhere, while their household remained at Ykerslund.

people.name: Ulfgeir
people.life: Settled repeated woodland boundary arguments by walking them himself and values a witnessed boundary over an inherited boast.
people.dream: regain responsibility for woodland stewardship
people.appearanceFamily: heart-shaped face, narrow nose and hazel eyes

people.name: Ingvora
people.life: Kept seed grain apart from feast stores during a hard winter and is praised as prudent by some and miserly by others.
people.dream: secure a dependable winter reserve
people.appearanceFamily: heart-shaped face, narrow nose and hazel eyes

people.name: Asvald
people.life: Oversaw timber carts until a broken axle injured a carter; he now checks fittings with an intensity that irritates companions.
people.dream: be trusted with a difficult building project
people.appearanceFamily: heart-shaped face, narrow nose and hazel eyes

people.name: Ragnel
people.life: Learned healing dressings from an elderly attendant and quietly argues that good service deserves proper payment.
people.dream: build a modest practice of her own
people.appearanceFamily: heart-shaped face, narrow nose and hazel eyes

people.name: Bjarnulf
people.life: Won local wrestling contests before a younger rival exposed his poor endurance; he has begun running instead of making excuses.
people.dream: earn a victory that cannot be dismissed as luck
people.appearanceFamily: heart-shaped face, narrow nose and hazel eyes

people.name: Alvheid
people.life: Collects songs from visiting households and carefully records who actually taught each verse.
people.dream: preserve the voices of overlooked singers
people.appearanceFamily: heart-shaped face, narrow nose and hazel eyes

households.history: An old marriage alliance brought the Bjornholt family to Brunmark; they hold standing in the hall but own no fief.

people.name: Hakonar
people.life: Served as an intermediary between suspicious marriage kin and learned that silence can postpone a quarrel without settling it.
people.dream: be remembered as more than a useful in-law
people.appearanceFamily: broad face, heavy brows and brown eyes

people.name: Gudnyra
people.life: Arrived with fewer marriage goods than promised and built influence through knowing exactly who had helped her.
people.dream: give her children choices she lacked
people.appearanceFamily: broad face, heavy brows and brown eyes

people.name: Skegvar
people.life: Was refused a place in a prestigious retinue and conceals the rejection beneath exaggerated judgments of other men.
people.dream: earn a command on his own merits
people.appearanceFamily: broad face, heavy brows and brown eyes

people.name: Brynveig
people.life: Organizes the family visits with painstaking attention to seating and dislikes being thanked only for looking gracious.
people.dream: receive credit for her political judgment
people.appearanceFamily: broad face, heavy brows and brown eyes

people.name: Ottmar
people.life: Spent a season assisting a smith and prefers the honesty of a visible flaw to the hall practice of concealing one.
people.dream: make something worthy of lasting use
people.appearanceFamily: broad face, heavy brows and brown eyes

people.name: Eirhild
people.life: Befriended servants who carried news between the kitchens and the hall, but once repeated a confidence she should have kept.
people.dream: become someone a confidence can safely reach
people.appearanceFamily: broad face, heavy brows and brown eyes

households.history: The family lost its grazing estate through successive divisions; Fimbulgard gives them residence, not ownership.

people.name: Vemund
people.life: Sold the last inherited grazing rights to settle an obligation and is determined that his children will not inherit the debt.
people.dream: leave a clear account instead of a grand claim
people.appearanceFamily: angular cheekbones, rounded chin and green eyes

people.name: Helgrun
people.life: Managed the divided household stores and remembers which relations offered help without demanding public gratitude.
people.dream: keep her children close without binding their lives
people.appearanceFamily: angular cheekbones, rounded chin and green eyes

people.name: Sigvard
people.life: Served on winter watches and discovered that he is better at steady routines than the heroic speeches he once admired.
people.dream: be chosen for dependable service
people.appearanceFamily: angular cheekbones, rounded chin and green eyes

people.name: Torveig
people.life: Exchanged woven work for books and has begun questioning claims about distant lands that no traveler confirms.
people.dream: see a southern city for herself
people.appearanceFamily: angular cheekbones, rounded chin and green eyes

people.name: Arnkel
people.life: Trained with an older retainer whose injury ended his prospects and worries that one accident could erase every plan.
people.dream: find a useful trade alongside fighting
people.appearanceFamily: angular cheekbones, rounded chin and green eyes

people.name: Ylfruna
people.life: Took over tending an elderly relative during a winter illness and discovered that kindness did not make her endlessly patient.
people.dream: make room for her own life without abandoning kin
people.appearanceFamily: angular cheekbones, rounded chin and green eyes

households.history: The Dalskeld household came upriver as oath-bound retainers; their place at Haugr depends on service, not land revenue.

people.name: Ormvald
people.life: Escorted river cargo in his youth and will walk away from a profitable undertaking if its promises cannot be checked.
people.dream: be entrusted with a difficult negotiation
people.appearanceFamily: soft oval face, straight nose and blue-grey eyes

people.name: Astruna
people.life: Learned weights and measures from river merchants and can enjoy a hard bargain without treating the other party as a fool.
people.dream: secure modest independent household earnings
people.appearanceFamily: soft oval face, straight nose and blue-grey eyes

people.name: Hrolgeir
people.life: Lost a race after choosing a reckless crossing and now studies water levels before boasting about speed.
people.dream: command respect without needless risks
people.appearanceFamily: soft oval face, straight nose and blue-grey eyes

people.name: Sigrild
people.life: Learned two neighboring dialects while staying with river kin and is tired of being treated as a mouthpiece without opinions.
people.dream: negotiate in her own name
people.appearanceFamily: soft oval face, straight nose and blue-grey eyes

people.name: Oddrik
people.life: Avoided a brawl by making an apology he did not believe and still struggles with whether survival justified it.
people.dream: learn when a concession protects dignity
people.appearanceFamily: soft oval face, straight nose and blue-grey eyes

people.name: Hervora
people.life: Counts the boats entering the river when she needs quiet and keeps a private ledger of seasons and weather.
people.dream: make a useful record others will consult
people.appearanceFamily: soft oval face, straight nose and blue-grey eyes

households.history: A wreck ended the family share in an island trading venture; the household found a permanent place at Hakarshus.

people.name: Gudbrand
people.life: Survived the wreck that consumed the family venture and resents easy promises that fortune always rewards courage.
people.dream: rebuild a reputation for sound judgment
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

people.name: Thorve
people.life: Had to bargain for winter lodging after the wreck and now keeps practical friendships beyond noble company.
people.dream: ensure hospitality never becomes dependence
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

people.name: Kolbein
people.life: Was ashore when the trading boat was lost and is weary of being asked to explain an accident he never witnessed.
people.dream: find work separate from the wreck story
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

people.name: Hildrun
people.life: Copied the names of the drowned for their relatives and distinguishes speaking for the dead from speaking over the living.
people.dream: give bereaved families a careful hearing
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

people.name: Eilvard
people.life: Took ordinary harbor work to help the family and bristles when guests describe honest labor as an amusing disguise.
people.dream: receive respect without concealing his past work
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

people.name: Svanlaug
people.life: Learned to swim from fisher children and does not share the family habit of treating the sea only as a source of grief.
people.dream: travel freely while honoring her family losses
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

households.history: A younger branch of a divided lineage, the Skeldrings retain court standing at Skarthness but no separate estate.

people.name: Ragnvald
people.life: Yielded seniority in a contested lineage to preserve peace and carefully separates courtesy from submission.
people.dream: win recognition for service rather than ancestry
people.appearanceFamily: square jaw, straight brows and grey-blue eyes

people.name: Yrveig
people.life: Made a respected household from gifts that richer relatives considered scraps and dislikes unnecessary display.
people.dream: make prosperity durable instead of visible
people.appearanceFamily: square jaw, straight brows and grey-blue eyes

people.name: Haraldin
people.life: Carried a ceremonial banner before learning how little ceremonial precedence decides in a hungry camp.
people.dream: prove capable of practical command
people.appearanceFamily: square jaw, straight brows and grey-blue eyes

people.name: Vigdis
people.life: Refused to repeat a convenient accusation against a rival branch and has paid for the refusal in lost invitations.
people.dream: hold influence without trading away fair dealing
people.appearanceFamily: square jaw, straight brows and grey-blue eyes

people.name: Holmgeir
people.life: Enjoys praise too readily and once claimed credit for a companion plan; the companion has not forgotten it.
people.dream: earn a compliment he does not have to steal
people.appearanceFamily: square jaw, straight brows and grey-blue eyes

people.name: Estruna
people.life: Keeps pressed plants from visits to relatives and associates each with the person who showed her the place.
people.dream: maintain friendships beyond the family faction
people.appearanceFamily: square jaw, straight brows and grey-blue eyes

households.history: The Lindeskars relinquished an unworkable hill claim and entered service at Ulikshorn, bringing their family together.

people.name: Thorgest
people.life: Abandoned a costly hill claim before it ruined the household and is willing to look cautious when others demand a gesture.
people.dream: leave his children useful standing rather than a lawsuit
people.appearanceFamily: heart-shaped face, narrow nose and hazel eyes

people.name: Jorhild
people.life: Kept peace between her husband and resentful cousins after the abandoned claim and no longer mistakes harmony for agreement.
people.dream: speak plainly without breaking every bond
people.appearanceFamily: heart-shaped face, narrow nose and hazel eyes

people.name: Arnbjorn
people.life: Mapped the poor hill ground his father relinquished and privately agrees that keeping it would have been folly.
people.dream: be consulted for what he knows
people.appearanceFamily: heart-shaped face, narrow nose and hazel eyes

people.name: Freydisa
people.life: Learned provisioning by comparing extravagant feast promises with the actual stores behind the kitchen door.
people.dream: manage a household without hidden shortages
people.appearanceFamily: heart-shaped face, narrow nose and hazel eyes

people.name: Vigdar
people.life: Became close to a low-born practice partner and refuses suggestions that their friendship should stop at the hall threshold.
people.dream: keep a friendship despite social pressure
people.appearanceFamily: heart-shaped face, narrow nose and hazel eyes

people.name: Rannlaug
people.life: Spent childhood hearing that a recovered claim would solve everything and now asks what people intend to do afterward.
people.dream: build a future that does not depend on old grievances
people.appearanceFamily: heart-shaped face, narrow nose and hazel eyes

households.history: The Beinholts came to Hvalvik with an island settlement venture; surviving kin now maintain a landless court household.

people.name: Hrafngeir
people.life: Helped survey a northern landing place but lost his investment when supplies failed; he distrusts ventures without winter plans.
people.dream: organize one venture that repays its obligations
people.appearanceFamily: broad face, heavy brows and brown eyes

people.name: Ingvelda
people.life: Bargained for shelter during the venture collapse and learned which forms of generosity carry an unspoken price.
people.dream: offer help without purchasing obedience
people.appearanceFamily: broad face, heavy brows and brown eyes

people.name: Skarvald
people.life: Returned from an unsuccessful voyage with more practical knowledge than profit and is tired of treating that as a disgrace.
people.dream: earn respect as an experienced voyager
people.appearanceFamily: broad face, heavy brows and brown eyes

people.name: Thorlaug
people.life: Records island family births and marriages to correct quarrels that begin with conveniently shortened memories.
people.dream: make an account both feuding branches accept
people.appearanceFamily: broad face, heavy brows and brown eyes

people.name: Audrik
people.life: Apprenticed briefly to a bone carver and values the patient finish of a small object more than loud ambition.
people.dream: sell work on the strength of its quality
people.appearanceFamily: broad face, heavy brows and brown eyes

people.name: Eydlaug
people.life: Learned court manners while sharing crowded lodging with distant kin and still seeks quiet when a hall becomes overfull.
people.dream: find a place that feels hers without shutting out kin
people.appearanceFamily: broad face, heavy brows and brown eyes

households.history: Long associated with visiting merchants, the Seilvaags hold noble standing at Gretysfjord without owning harbor dues or land.

people.name: Eirikmar
people.life: Witnessed trade agreements for visiting captains and has lost friendships by insisting that the spoken terms be written down.
people.dream: be trusted by people who otherwise distrust each other
people.appearanceFamily: angular cheekbones, rounded chin and green eyes

people.name: Borghild
people.life: Built a network of small favors while managing visiting kin and fears turning every friendship into another obligation.
people.dream: enjoy companionship without bargaining
people.appearanceFamily: angular cheekbones, rounded chin and green eyes

people.name: Torstenar
people.life: Failed to impress a rich captain by boasting and learned that asking a useful question can carry more weight.
people.dream: be invited aboard for skill rather than connections
people.appearanceFamily: angular cheekbones, rounded chin and green eyes

people.name: Solveira
people.life: Keeps patterns copied from foreign textiles and insists that appreciating another fashion need not make her ashamed of her own.
people.dream: design a distinctive woven border
people.appearanceFamily: angular cheekbones, rounded chin and green eyes

people.name: Hallgeir
people.life: Once passed along an exaggerated price rumor and saw it harm a supplier he liked; he now checks stories before repeating them.
people.dream: repair trust with people he misled
people.appearanceFamily: angular cheekbones, rounded chin and green eyes

people.name: Fridrun
people.life: Enjoys hearing visiting speakers disagree and has begun noting the moments when a joke conceals an insult.
people.dream: learn to speak sharply without becoming cruel
people.appearanceFamily: angular cheekbones, rounded chin and green eyes

households.history: The Tingalunds trace their service to assembly gatherings; their residence at Thronderlag conveys neither a fief nor a council seat.

people.name: Aunvald
people.life: Served as a witness at difficult settlements and dislikes the tendency to remember only the loudest man in the circle.
people.dream: be heard for careful judgment in old age
people.appearanceFamily: soft oval face, straight nose and blue-grey eyes

people.name: Gydeva
people.life: Learned how ceremonial hospitality can turn a poor host into a debtor and quietly scales gatherings to what can be afforded.
people.dream: preserve dignity without buying applause
people.appearanceFamily: soft oval face, straight nose and blue-grey eyes

people.name: Sigtrygg
people.life: Memorized ancestral speeches before realizing that repeating them could conceal the absence of a present answer.
people.dream: find words that answer the actual dispute
people.appearanceFamily: soft oval face, straight nose and blue-grey eyes

people.name: Ragnhildra
people.life: Challenges a family account that erases an inconvenient marriage and will not sacrifice an absent woman reputation for a neat story.
people.dream: produce an honest family chronicle
people.appearanceFamily: soft oval face, straight nose and blue-grey eyes

people.name: Ulfrik
people.life: Was praised for courage after obeying an order he barely understood and now asks questions that senior men find impertinent.
people.dream: deserve trust for judgment as well as nerve
people.appearanceFamily: soft oval face, straight nose and blue-grey eyes

people.name: Asveiga
people.life: Volunteered to help guests find lodging and discovered how quickly a minor slight can become a public grievance.
people.dream: make overlooked people feel accurately remembered
people.appearanceFamily: soft oval face, straight nose and blue-grey eyes

households.history: The Elverdals moved between river kin before settling at Hargard; they remain a noble household without taxable holdings.

people.name: Bjarngrim
people.life: Mediated disputes between river traders and insists on hearing an account in the speaker own words before accepting a translation.
people.dream: be useful across communities without owning their voices
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

people.name: Ragnora
people.life: Maintained ties on both sides of an old marriage dispute and keeps private grief separate from public hospitality.
people.dream: keep family ties from becoming rival camps
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

people.name: Steinkel
people.life: Helped carry a stranded cargo inland and discovered a talent for organizing tired people without shouting at them.
people.dream: earn responsibility for a real logistical task
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

people.name: Odhild
people.life: Learned medicinal preparation from women in several river households and is careful to say when a remedy may not help.
people.dream: be trusted for honesty about her limits
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

people.name: Haldorik
people.life: Resents being called provincial and once pretended to understand a foreign joke; he has since begun learning the language properly.
people.dream: be confident without pretending knowledge
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes

people.name: Gunnveig
people.life: Traded small carved tokens with childhood friends from different river communities and worries that court loyalties will divide them.
people.dream: keep friendships intact as public loyalties harden
people.appearanceFamily: long oval face, broad cheekbones and grey-green eyes
